title: Force Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the force of attraction between the two magnetic dipoles.

title: Torque Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the torque experienced by the misaligned dipole.

title: Field Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should express the magnetic field produced by the first dipole at the location of the second dipole.

title: Alignment Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the torque affects the alignment of the second dipole with respect to the magnetic field.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the force and torque calculations.
